name: Second Term
detailed_description:
Second Term - Presidential Simulator

As the president you have a lot of responsibilities, how you act on them is entirely your choice. Become the most powerful and feared dictator or be an inspiring progressive leader, with every executive order signed you can change the future of your country in any way possible. But be careful, the only thing that really matters is getting elected for your Second Term, your actions will decide how easy this will be.

Key Features

  • Multiplayer Chaos - Play together with your friends! Since there can only be one president at a time, all other players have different roles such as assistant, guard or military general with their own tasks and gadgets.

  • Policy Making - Pass new laws to change the course of your country, every decision impacts your popularity with certain demographics. Feed the poor or strengthen the power of the elites, it’s your choice.

  • Crisis Management - Try handling everything from environmental catastrophes to social media disasters. You never know who will profit from your mistakes, so keep an eye out for every opportunity and your enemies.

  • International Relations - Negotiate with other leaders, your country is not the only one around. Keep cool and try to get the best deals possible. Your images counts, even in the darkest hours.

  • Media Relations - Survive press conferences and social media storms, be prepared for exposing questions and try to answer honestly, or just ignore them, what are they supposed to do? You can always prohibit the distribution of guillotines.

  • Management Government Spending - For your people to remain happy and content they need infrastructure, education and social security. Develop the perfect financing plan or just lose all your money at the stock market.

short_description: Become the leader of your own country in this hilarious 3D presidential simulator! Sign executive orders (reading optional), deal with unforeseen crises and try not to accidentally start a war. Will the people love you or do you have to force your Second Term the hard way?
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Russian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 9 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Cartoony simplified consumption of drugs and other illegal activities. It also contains non-realistic violence in the form of melee and firearm combat.
